headline: Wardens Surge on Nevish Line, Seven Posts to One
war_summary: The Nevish Line has changed countenance since our last edition: where four banners apiece flew at morning, Warden colours now stand over seven of eight strongpoints, the Colonials clinging to a single post, and the ground about Princefal, Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way has not rested — forty-three flag actions in the day, with better than five thousand casualties on either side. Marban Hollow has swung once more, the Wardens now leading four posts to three, Checkpoint Bua again the busiest field. Weathered Expanse remains the war's costliest front, near seven thousand Warden and six and a half thousand Colonial losses counted in twenty-four hours, the Wardens having recovered a second post there while Crow's Nest takes the heaviest pounding. Linn Mercy's lull has broken, Warden casualties about Lathair rising sharply in the latest hours. Kuura Strand stays divided, four Colonials to two Wardens, with Faden Point the most worked shore. Godcrofts recorded minor exchanges at Argosa and Lipsia, while Callahans Passage, without a single flag event, nonetheless counted better than five thousand further losses. Thirty-four victory towns are required; no victor is declared.
